svg.title: BraTS data flow from approved source to run artifacts
svg.desc: A left-to-right BraTS path moves from approved three-dimensional NIfTI source layouts through preparation, canonical cases, discovery, a persisted split manifest, dataset and transform builders, and training, evaluation, and artifacts. A separate lower lane shows the independent two-dimensional CNN ImageFolder denoising pretraining path.

g.text: From approved volumes to trusted run artifacts
Canonicalize once. Preserve modality order, region order, and split identity all the way through evaluation.
3-D NIfTI · raw labels kept until conversion
approved source → canonical cases → manifest-backed loaders → train, score, and record
train patches, val/test volumes or slices
2-D denoising pretraining; does not consume canonical BraTS cases or the split manifest
2-D image classes under configured image root
Read arrows as ownership boundaries: source preparation is separate from label conversion; persisted split identity is checked before loaders are built.
